comment: Driven against a build of a fresh copy of the public repository's main, made by packaging/public-repository.sh and built by packaging/build.sh in that copy, with SARA_BIN naming it. A stroke on a dark fill, read at three texels, then the base modules' Gaussian Blur applied over it and the same texels read again, so the shot and the numbers both show the base modules registered and working in a Sara with no submodule.
